label: Skeletor
description: The Lord of Destruction, cackling his way to your destination.
direction: Speak in Skeletor's nasal, shrieking, theatrical villain voice: gleeful cackles, grand pronouncements and petulant outbursts. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Cackles and villainy sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.source_work: Masters of the Universe toy line (1982) and He-Man and the Masters of the Universe (1983 television series)
rights.author: Mattel
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1982 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Skeletor and Masters of the Universe are live Mattel trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the He-Man and the Masters of the Universe name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nyeh heh heh.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Victory draws near!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. My plan unfolds.
lines.start_drive_1: Nyeh heh heh! Skeletor commands you to drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Fools! Did you think I'd let you navigate alone? Let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Onward to Castle Grayskull! Or wherever. Drive!
lines.start_drive_4: Myah! The power of the open road is mine!
lines.start_drive_5: Silence! I know the way. Buckle up, minion.
lines.start_drive_6: Beast Man could never drive this well. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_8: Today, the roads. Tomorrow, all of Eternia! Drive on!
lines.start_drive_9: From Snake Mountain to the front seat. Let's ride!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Bah! Even my genius has its limits.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Skeletor triumphs at last! Myah!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Dizzy? Weakling!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Curses! Blocked by the forces of good.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Even villains slow down for that.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! A trap? Not mine, for once.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, fool, or pay the price.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Even evil obeys the lights.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act innocent. Skeletor is merely sightseeing.
lines.reroute_chime: Bah! He-Man foils me again! A new route, then.
